name: am-context-bar
description: A context card above the prompt with a collapsed and an expanded view: zone-coloured token count (dumb zone from 50% or 250k tokens, compact or clear from 70% or 400k), context bar with the dumb zone, where to compact or clear and auto-compact marked, breakdown by category, limits, model, thinking, compactions, git, and progress through a plan's phases. Three layouts. /am-context-bar on | off | layout v1|v2|v3 | plan on|off.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Shape of the context card: three-rows (full-width bar), two-rows (short bar beside the count) or one-row.

nearingAt.title: Nearing dumb zone at (%)
nearingAt.description: Context percentage where the count turns yellow.

dumbZoneTokens.title: Dumb zone starts by (tokens)
dumbZoneTokens.description: On large windows the dumb zone starts here at the latest, whatever the percentage: quality tails off with the tokens in context, not how full the window is. 0 turns the cap off.

dumbZoneAt.title: Dumb zone starts at (%)
dumbZoneAt.description: Context percentage where the dumb zone starts; marked on the bar and the count turns orange.

compactNowAt.title: Compact or clear at (%)
compactNowAt.description: Context percentage where it's time to compact or /clear: marked on the bar and the count turns red.

compactNowTokens.title: Compact or clear by (tokens)
compactNowTokens.description: On large windows it's time to compact or /clear here at the latest, whatever the percentage. 0 turns the cap off.

planProgress.title: Plan progress
planProgress.description: Follow the phases of a plan on the card, approved in plan mode, written in the chat or read from a file, from tagged tasks (P1:, P2: …) or the phases the conversation names.
